# Source-to-claim audit

**Summary:** 47 Cited claims re-verified against the cited source spans (every row of 10.1, every workflow, every connection and external call); 4 claims corrected relative to the previous version of this document; 7 claims kept as Inferred or Unknown because the source alone does not establish them. No tests were run and no code was executed (Flask is not installed in the audit environment), so runtime behavior is read from source only.

## Evidence Register

All re-run commands are PowerShell, run from the Target root.

## Corrections

- **Section 9 and 7.6 (search failures).** The previous version said the search page "errors or shows nothing" because of `entry.post_id`. Reading `project/templates/search.html:50-57` shows the page still lists matches; only the heading id is blank. Claim corrected, and the click-delete consequence is marked Inferred.
- **Section 7.4 and 9 (missing form field).** The previous version said a missing field raises a "400/500". Only a 400 is plausible for Flask's request form; written as Inferred at 400.
- **Section 7.5 / 16.5 (CI line numbers).** Lint and test steps are at `.github/workflows/main.yml:23-29`, not lines 24 and 28 as in the previous version.
- **Section 10.1 (scope).** Findings S9 to S13 were added; they were absent from the previous version. S10 is the credential-bearing URL in `README.md:1663`, reported without its value.
- **Downgraded to Inferred:** S11, S12, the blank-id click behavior in S5, the default server error on database failure (7.3, 8.5), the 400 for a missing form field (7.4, 9), and the CDN-outage styling effect (8.5). The ignore-file claim S9 relies on `git ls-files`, which has no line citation.
